text: She owned migration of 9 payment services to a new event bus, reduced checkout failure rate from 2.4% to 0.7% in two quarters, and documented the rollback runbook used in two incidents.

She is brilliant, hardworking, proactive, and always exceeds expectations in every project.
He is a great communicator and an amazing teammate who consistently brings positive energy.
They are outstanding and highly reliable, and I would strongly recommend them to anyone.
